units.translation: He speaks the best of the present circumstances.
I tell you.
I tell you the fate of the murderous cauldron.
For he does not speak well.
To come upon a city speaking a foreign tongue.
I was ashamed to say these things.
Such things as the tongue of a hateful dog, having spoken and having killed the bright-minded—
You do not speak of a Syrian adornment for the house.
I tell you my opinion.
I do not know what counsel I have obtained in speaking.
I speak to those who know.
And I tell you.
It is not fitting for you to say this care.
Since you seem to do and say these things.
You say to those who receive that you will die.
Whether speaking to bring from a dear wife to her husband?
You might speak, if you have anything better than these.
I will speak, since you bid me, the word from my heart.
You might speak.
Do you mean a judge or a housekeeper?
I speak calling, father, and pity me and dear Orestes.
Speaking to them this evil curse.
You tell me things no less worthy of tears.
You have spoken everything dishonorably.
You speak of your father's fate.
As she herself says.
Who could speak of the over-bold thought of the man?
It might be said, if it is necessary.
If I happen to speak to those who have authority and are fitting.
Speak again.
Speaking a word without aim.
I hear that some report a new saying.
He speaks from an obscure report, having learned.
What am I to say?
I mean that the living kill the dead.
I mean all the Argives, and that they bear witness for me.
Terrible things to say.
I do not mean women, but Gorgons.
I spoke about my own life.
I know how to speak where justice is.
And to speak the lots among men, how faction distributes them.
I speak to all in common.
And being shapeless, to speak ill of one's neighbors—
If someone should speak a clear word.
Having spoken of the land and the race.
I will tell you a great proof of these things.
I speak a measured word.
What share do you have in this matter? Speak.
Speaking first from the beginning.
I say.
We will speak briefly.
I will speak to you.
As you say.
How do you not say these things contrary to them?
I will say this too.
You say.
What need is there to speak?
I do not speak of the battle of the house bird.
I will not tire of telling you the good things.
For it is possible for me not to say what I do not accomplish.
I speak of my own favor.
Speaking clearly these bloodless exiles.
Do I speak to you as to a kinsman?
Speak boldly to me.
You might boast of your race and speak further.
What all-seeing shepherd do you mean?
And you have said all these things in agreement with me.
What other offspring of this woman do you mean?
Do you speak out of enmity or because it is not lawful?
You might speak.
Speak.
You have spoken a pollution not to be outshot.
For the stranger speaks well.
You, both in speaking and in acting, gladden my heart.
Such things one must say.
And speaking of this race, you might trace it from Epaphus.
He was persuading with such a speech about us.
Speaking of a double pollution.
Let us speak good prayers for the Argives.
I speak to one who knows.
I might say (thus Heathius for λέγοις) these things to the sons of Aegyptus, having come.
Why must I tell you the name?
As the old writing says.
I say that you should honor me as a man, not as a god.
But to your enemies I say that you, father, appear as an avenger.
Saying to kill in the same manner.
